description.value: A Class 12 hyperdrive. Hyperdrive rating is inverse to speed — lower is faster. A Class 12 hyperdrive completes a jump in 12× the Class 1 baseline travel time, making it slower than hyperspeed standard. Engaging the hyperdrive requires an action, and the pilot must then spend at least 50 feet of flying speed before the end of the turn or the jump attempt resets.
